opportunities.name: Tech lead research note (HN + GitHub -> note)
opportunities.description: For a given software project name, look up its HN story (points, age) and GitHub repo (stars, latest release), then save a 'Lead:' note summarizing them.
steps: Search project name on Hacker News (or Algolia HN search) and note top story title, points, age
Open GitHub search, type project name, press Enter
Click the top repo result and read stars and latest release
Open notes app, click New note
Type 'Lead: <project>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>' and press Enter
